当王建新来到铁丝网这边，看了看对面的雪，心里琢磨了一下。

不能留下痕迹。

上次去蒙古国，草原还全是青草，踩着脚印也没人追查。但现在不一样了，乌兰巴托那档子事出了以后，对面肯定加强了戒备。要是被人在雪地上发现一串脚印，顺着摸过来，麻烦就大了。

他深吸一口气，轻轻一跃，越过了铁丝网。

落在苏联这边的雪地上，脚尖先着地，然后整个脚掌轻轻落下——几乎没有声音，也没有留下痕迹。雪面上只有一个浅浅的小坑，风一吹就没了。

王建新低头看了看，满意地点了点头。

“修仙功法可比轻功强多了。”他现在全力运转灵气的时候，身体轻得像一片树叶，落在地上连雪都不带压实的。这要是搁以前，一脚踩下去，雪能没到小腿肚子，拔出来都费劲。

他在雪地上开始极速奔跑。

灵气在体内疯狂运转，灌注到双腿。每一次落地，身体都像被弹出去一样，往前窜出十几米远。脚落在雪面上，只是轻轻一点，连个印子都没留下。炼气三层的身体素质加上灵气加持，跑起来比骑马快多了。耳边风声呼呼的，两边的雪原飞速后退。

跑了大约十几公里的时候，王建新觉得差不多了，放慢脚步，从空间里放出一匹马。

马一出来，四条腿就陷进了雪里，没过膝盖。马打了个响鼻，挣扎着往前走了两步，喘着粗气，走得很费劲。这边的雪比蒙古国那边还深，一脚下去就是一个大坑。

“不行。”王建新摇了摇头，把马又收回了空间。

在这么深的雪里，马匹也跑不起来。别说是蒙古马了，就是苏联那边的大挽马来了也得陷进去。看来只能靠自己奔跑了。

“也不知道现在有没有雪上摩托车之类的。”王建新一边跑一边想，“有的话这次搞一个。”

雪上摩托车这东西，后世很常见，但这个年代不知道有没有。苏联这么冷的地方，应该有吧？实在不行，装甲车在这上面倒是能开，雪再深也不怕。但关键是太招摇了。开着装甲车在苏联境内跑，那不是找打吗？

“算了，自己跑吧，就当锻炼了。”

炼气三层真不是吹的。王建新全力奔跑起来，速度比骑马快了一大截，而且也没感觉到累。灵气在体内源源不断地运转，提供着动力。他感觉自己像一台永动机，跑多久都不会停。

不知不觉，一路奔跑着，大概跑了两个多小时。

王建新估算了一下距离，两个小时，按他的速度，怎么也得有一百多里地了。但四周还是白茫茫的雪原，连个人影都没有。

“这也不是个办法呀。”王建新一边跑一边想，“不行要不坐火车吧。”

火车不受雪的影响，铁轨是露出来的，跑得快，还省力。而且坐火车比他两条腿跑快多了，也能让他歇一歇。

他改变了方向，开始找火车轨道。

又跑了将近一个小时，终于发现了铁轨。两条铁轨从雪原上延伸过来，伸向远方，枕木被雪埋了一半，但铁轨面是露出来的，被来来往往的火车轮子磨得锃亮。

王建新跳上铁轨，顺着轨道开始跑。铁轨比雪地好跑多了，踩在枕木上，有弹性，不滑。

跑了没多远，他发现前面好像有个小站。几间低矮的房子，一个站台，信号杆上挂着灯。但站里没看到火车，静悄悄的，连个人影都没有。

王建新绕过车站，顺着铁道的方向继续奔跑。他不想进站，万一被人看见了麻烦。沿着铁路线跑，安全。

回空间恢复了一下，然后又奔跑了一个多小时，王建新的神识忽然感应到了什么。

前面有震动，顺着铁轨传过来的。很轻微，但炼气三层的感知力让他捕捉到了。是火车。不是停着的，是在疾驰的火车，车轮碾过铁轨，产生的震动顺着轨道传过来。

“看来是刚从车站走了的火车。”王建新加快了速度，朝着震动的方向追去。

他调动了体内所有的灵气，灌注到双腿，速度瞬间飙升。两边的景物飞速后退，风声在耳边尖啸。铁轨在前方延伸，越来越清晰。

When Wang Jianxin came to the barbed wire fence, he looked at the snow on the opposite side and thought about it.

Leave no trace.

The last time I went to Mongolia, the grasslands were still full of green grass, and no one traced my footprints.But things are different now. After what happened in Ulaanbaatar, the other side must have stepped up their vigilance.If someone finds a set of footprints in the snow and follows them, you'll be in big trouble.

He took a deep breath, jumped slightly, and crossed the barbed wire fence.

Landing on the snow on the Soviet side, the toes touched the ground first, and then the whole sole of the foot fell gently - almost no sound, and no traces were left.There was only a shallow hole in the snow, and it disappeared when the wind blew.

Wang Jianxin looked down and nodded with satisfaction.

"The Immortal Cultivation Technique is much stronger than the Qinggong Technique." When he was running his spiritual energy with all his strength, his body was as light as a leaf, and it fell to the ground without even being compacted by snow.If this had been done before, if I stepped on it, the snow would reach my calf, and it would be difficult to pull it out.

He started running very fast on the snow.

The spiritual energy circulates crazily in the body, pouring into the legs.Every time he landed, his body seemed to be ejected, and he jumped forward more than ten meters.The foot landed lightly on the snow, not even leaving a mark.With the physical quality of the third level of Qi refining and the blessing of spiritual energy, running is much faster than riding a horse.The wind roared in my ears, and the snowfields on both sides retreated rapidly.

After running for about ten kilometers, Wang Jianxin felt that it was almost done, so he slowed down and released a horse from the space.

As soon as the horse came out, its four legs sank into the snow, up to its knees.The horse snorted and struggled to take two steps forward, panting heavily and walking very hard.The snow here is deeper than that in Mongolia, and there is a big hole when you step into it.

"No." Wang Jianxin shook his head and took the horse back into space.

Horses cannot run in such deep snow.Not to mention the Mongolian horses, even the big draft horses from the Soviet Union had to be trapped when they came.It seems that I can only run on my own.

"I don't know if there are snowmobiles or the like now." Wang Jianxin thought as he ran, "If there is, I'll get one this time."

Snowmobiles were very common in later generations, but I don’t know if they existed in this era.There must be a place as cold as the Soviet Union, right?It really doesn't work, but armored vehicles can drive here, no matter how deep the snow is.But the key is that it's too ostentatious.Driving an armored vehicle across the Soviet Union, isn't that looking for a fight?

"Forget it, just run by yourself and treat it as exercise."

The third level of Qi refining is really not just for fun.Wang Jianxin ran with all his strength, much faster than riding a horse, and he didn't feel tired.Spiritual energy circulates continuously in the body, providing power.He felt like a perpetual motion machine that would never stop running.

Before I knew it, I was running all the way for probably more than two hours.

Wang Jianxin estimated the distance. In two hours, at his speed, it would be more than a hundred miles.But there was still a vast white snowfield all around, with not even a single person in sight.

"This is not a solution." Wang Jianxin thought as he ran, "If that doesn't work, why not take the train."

The train is not affected by the snow and the rails are exposed, so it can run fast and save effort.Moreover, taking the train is much faster than running on two legs, and it also allows him to take a break.

He changed direction and started looking for train tracks.

After running for nearly an hour, I finally found the railroad tracks.Two railway tracks extended from the snowfield into the distance. The sleepers were half buried by the snow, but the track surface was exposed and was polished by the wheels of the trains coming and going.

Wang Jianxin jumped on the railroad track and started running along the track.The rails are much easier to run on than the snow. When you step on the sleepers, they are elastic and not slippery.

After running not far, he found that there seemed to be a small station in front of him.Several low houses, a station, and lights hung on signal poles.But there was no train in sight at the station. It was quiet, not even a human figure.

Wang Jianxin bypassed the station and continued running in the direction of the railway.He didn't want to go into the station in case someone saw him and got into trouble.Run along the railway line and be safe.

After returning to space to recover for a while, and then running for more than an hour, Wang Jianxin's consciousness suddenly sensed something.

There was a vibration ahead, coming along the rails.It was very slight, but the perception of the third level of Qi Refining allowed him to catch it.It's a train.It's not a stationary train, it's a speeding train. The wheels run over the rails, and the vibrations generated are transmitted along the rails.

"It looks like the train just left the station." Wang Jianxin sped up and chased in the direction of the vibration.

He mobilized all the spiritual energy in his body and poured it into his legs, causing his speed to surge instantly.The scenery on both sides retreated rapidly, and the wind screamed in my ears.The tracks stretched ahead, becoming increasingly clear.
